Here is a Python script to fetch June 2023 revisions for August day pages and count valid tweet citations inside refs:

import requests, re
S = requests.Session()
BASE = "https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php"
PAGES = [f"August {i}" for i in range(1,32)]
TW_PATTERN = re.compile(r"https?://(?:mobile\.)?twitter\.com/[^/]+/status/\d+", re.I)
REF_PATTERN = re.compile(r"<ref[\s\S]*?>[\s\S]*?<\/ref>", re.I)

def last_june_oldid(title):
    params = {
        "action": "query",
        "prop": "revisions",
        "titles": title,
        "rvstart": "2023-06-30T23:59:59Z",
        "rvend": "2023-06-01T00:00:00Z",
        "rvdir": "newer",
        "rvlimit": 500,
        "format": "json"
    }
    r = S.get(BASE, params=params).json()
    page = next(iter(r["query"]["pages"].values()))
    revs = page.get("revisions", [])
    june_revs = [rv for rv in revs if rv["timestamp"].startswith("2023-06")]
    return june_revs[-1]["revid"] if june_revs else None

def get_wikitext(oldid):
    params = {"action": "parse", "oldid": oldid, "prop": "wikitext", "format": "json"}
    r = S.get(BASE, params=params).json()
    return r["parse"]["wikitext"]["*"]

def count_tweet_refs(wikitext):
    refs = REF_PATTERN.findall(wikitext)
    return sum(1 for ref in refs if TW_PATTERN.search(ref))

results = {}
for title in PAGES:
    oid = last_june_oldid(title)
    if not oid:
        results[title] = 0
        continue
    wt = get_wikitext(oid)
    results[title] = count_tweet_refs(wt)
print(results)
print("TOTAL", sum(results.values()))
